from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentEvidence(BaseModel):
    """Evidence extracted from a single document to enable classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the document as provided (e.g. '《判决文书 1》')")
    case_type: str = Field(description="The broad legal nature of the case inferred from the document text (e.g., '民事', '刑事', '行政')")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action or dispute type mentioned (e.g., '行政协议', '分家析产', '故意伤害罪')")
    key_parties: list[str] = Field(description="Key parties involved (e.g., 'Plaintiff', 'Defendant', 'Government Bureau')")
    summary_of_facts: str = Field(description="Brief summary of the core legal facts driving the classification")
    supporting_quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentEvidence]
